For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: April 12th - May 23rd, 2015
  • Number of Images: 330 lines 
  • Resolution: 18 centimetre (RGBN)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (SocetSet model setup)
  • Camera(s):  Leica ADS100 line based

For more information on the South Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (SWOOP) 2015 please see the main SWOOP 2015 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • South Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (SWOOP) 2015 - Stereo Lines and associated Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, imagery@ontario.ca
